claims.statement: Management expects volume growth to be between 8% and 10% under current circumstances.
claims.quote: and therefore, anything in the volume, in the current context, which is between that 8% - 10% is a good growth, in terms of what I would say under the current circumstances.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management targets maintaining the operating margin guidance between the 18% and 20% band.
claims.quote: So, I would say that we would keep the guidance between that 18 and 20% band as we go ahead and that is something which we will endeavour to maintain.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management expects a volume-value gap of 4% to 5% to remain realistic in the market.
claims.quote: So, I would say that this 4%-5% is a more realistic thing which would remain in the market
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management expects value growth to be realistically around 5% to 6% in the next few quarters.
claims.quote: I think that is a reasonable take in terms of what we can look at.
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: The company launched a latex paint product named NeoBharat targeting the rural and unorganized market upgradation.
facts.quote: we had launched “NeoBharat” and we have been pursuing it very strongly. So, we have looked at the latex market, which is basically sold in “Kgs” across various markets.

facts.statement: The company maintains a strong internal cost model tackling both fixed and variable structural costs.
facts.quote: I think our strong ingredient has been the whole cost model, which we have broken up in a very big way. So, we are not relying on just the external deflation or the prices. We are working on a very strong cost model
